biography.html: Robert Pereira is an American construction entrepreneur who founded The Middlesex Corporation in Massachusetts. A third-generation paving worker, he learned the trade alongside his father and grandfather before starting his own company. He developed it from a small paving business into a major contractor building highways, bridges, railway facilities and other infrastructure.

long_biography.plain_text:
Producing construction materials became an important part of Robert Pereira's business strategy. Alongside contracting, he developed asphalt operations, acquired aggregate quarries and built an equipment purchasing and leasing arm. These activities supplied the machinery and materials needed by the broader group, extending its capabilities beyond the work performed on individual construction sites.

Pereira also prepared a family succession in management. His son, Robert Pereira II, began working at Middlesex as a teenager and gained experience across its operating areas. The elder Pereira handed him responsibility for daily operations in 2008, while retaining the chairman and chief executive titles.

confidence.reason: Full leadership account explicitly attributes material/equipment diversification and2008operating handover to him; current overview corroborates continuing titles and integrated group operations.
